title: Friend View
description:
Friend View lets you follow your friends' play in Slay the Spire 2 co-op through a dedicated read-only demo view. Watch their hand, energy, health, powers, relics, cursor, animated card selection and native targeting arrow. Keep watching a living teammate after your own character dies, and switch between friends in larger co-op parties.

[h2]Beyond combat[/h2]
Observe the full native reward window, available card rewards, shops, events, crystal-sphere predictions, maps and supported card-selection screens. Use the native upgrade-preview checkbox to inspect upgraded versions of all offered reward cards without changing real cards.

[h2]Simple controls[/h2]
In combat, click the eye above a teammate's character. Outside combat, use the eye beside their status in the player list. The active eye turns green. Click it again or press Esc to smoothly return to your own view.

When viewing card rewards, the only exit eye is to the right of the cards. Exit first to choose another friend in the player list.

[h2]Observation, not control[/h2]
You cannot play your friend's cards, buy their items, choose event options or claim rewards while observing. Your native End Turn button still ends your own turn. Exit demo to make your own choices. Card effects, combat rules and the save format are unchanged.

[h2]Supported screens and privacy[/h2]
Demo is unavailable at rest sites, relic choices including Ancient offers, personal menus and unknown third-party screens. Unsupported screens close the view automatically. Outside combat, players already observing someone else cannot themselves be observed.

Complex screens use read-only images of the game's viewport, up to four frames per second at 1280x720, only while someone is watching. This adds network traffic, capped at 768 KiB/s per source stream before host forwarding. The desktop, pause/settings and personal menus are never captured. The player list remains your local interface.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
Every lobby member must use matching game and Friend View versions. Enable it through the built-in mod loader. No additional loader or library is required.

[h2]Your normal progress[/h2]
When Friend View is the only successfully loaded cosmetic mod, the game uses your normal profile. With any other mod or loading error, the separate modded profile remains in use. This choice stays fixed until restart. Friend View does not copy, merge or delete save files; the game saves the selected profile normally. The MODDED indicator remains visible.

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
Select a teammate's combat character or player-list row using native navigation, then press the focused-selection action (default Xbox A). Cancel (B) exits. Confirm (Y) toggles reward-card upgrade previews; in combat it still ends YOUR turn. Native button hints follow the controller type and in-game remapping.
